about: Test leads for the n8n AI lead qualifier. All people and companies are fictional. E-mails and websites use subdomains of the reserved example.com domain (RFC 2606) and are served by tests/mock_sites/server.py. 'expected' lists the routes that count as correct for each lead; it is written before any run.
labels_reviewed: All 39 expected routes were reviewed one by one and settled by the owner on 2026-10-19 (4 labels narrowed: B05, A01, A02, B07). Before that date the labels were a Claude draft of 2026-10-16.
